profile.headline: SWE II & AI Ambassador @ JPMorganChase | MBA | M.S. AI ’27
profile.summary:
I am a dedicated generalist. At a glance, my occupations may seem somewhat divergent. 

Being a neuroscience major who fell in love with law, ventured into philosophy, and couldn't keep himself from coding may seem confusing. What drives this narrative is a passion for learning, an awareness of the world around me, and compassion that bridges the two.

I believe that fulfillment is seldom defined along a linear path; if only for myself, it is best realized while continuously growing and adapting to ever-evolving circumstances. 

For every change that I have embraced, for every cause that I have inherited, for every detour that I have taken, I am all the better and hope to offer increasingly meaningful contributions in consequence.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Microservice development, deployment, and production support for innovative products driving loan origination for millions of Chase customers nationwide.

Frontier development for AI tooling that transforms agentic capabilities within real enterprise-scale ecosystems.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Freelance web development for small businesses and professionals in the Philadelphia tri-state area.

positions.title: Management - Tech & Systems Adminstration
positions.description: Overall operations and technology management for passenger and employee-facing processes throughout Philadelphia Int'l Airport, including services in public information, ground transportation, and hospitality.

positions.title: Co-founder of Vipple
positions.description:
Executive operations and creative directorship of Vipple, including financing, operations, small contracts and policy handling, design, branding, and promotional activity.

We set out to develop a fully-fledged mobile application that could capture the fun and philanthropic energy of the internet in one place, ultimately sunsetting the application in 2017.
